title: 工作流程里，哪一步可以商量？ / Discuss one step in your work process

interpretations.headline: 留意一次看来多做了一遍的任务
interpretations.scoreLabel: 不合理任务感受（0–100 分）
interpretations.summary:
这道题记录你对工作中某些安排是否有必要的感受。越接近 100，表示你越认同自己遇到了看来没有必要做的事。它描述的是你的经验，不能代替对任务用途的核实。

This item describes how strongly you report being given work that seems unnecessary. Review the task's purpose and context before drawing conclusions.

guidance.text:
选一件你觉得重复的事，确认它在流程里起什么作用。如果同一个目标能用更少的步骤完成，跟相关同事讨论一种可以先试的小调整。

Pick one task that felt repetitive, check its purpose, and ask a colleague whether the same result could be achieved in fewer steps.

limitations: 只报告 IT1 单项分数。保留 Annex 1 的五档有序回答及 0、25、50、75、100 编码，不计算多题总分或分档。
IT1 is one ordinal response mapped to 0–100 using Annex response category 2. No multi-item total or normative bands are reported.
report.disclaimer: 用于成年工作人群的非商业研究与自我回顾。For non-commercial research with adult workers and personal reflection.
